meta.name: claukit
meta.description: Advanced Agentic Coding framework providing mission briefs, guardrails, and integration hints for complex tasks. This skill ensures high-quality output through disciplined automation and systematic workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用任务简报和护栏自动化复杂编码工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在复杂项目中保持代码质量和流程规范
copy.tagline_en: Automate complex coding workflows with mission briefs and guardrails
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to maintain code quality and process discipline in complex projects

howto.what: Claude 会先读取任务简报、护栏和集成提示，然后从本地技能目录中挑选 1-3 个最合适的技能来协作完成任务，并在完成前再次检查护栏。
howto.when: 当用户提到“claukit”或“ClaudeKit”，或者任务需要多个技能协作（如设计、计划、执行、审查、验证）时触发。

say.text: 用 claukit 帮我规划一个前后端项目。
say.note: Claude 会读取任务简报并选择相关技能。

say.text: 启动 claukit 调试流程，修复这个 bug。
say.note: Claude 会按调试链调用技能。

say.text: 用 claukit 风格审查这段代码。
say.note: Claude 会先读护栏再审查。

howto.what_en: Claude reads mission briefs, guardrails, and integration hints, then selects 1-3 most suitable skills from the local directory to collaborate on the task, and re-checks guardrails before completion.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions 'claukit' or 'ClaudeKit', or when the task requires coordination of multiple skills (e.g., design, planning, execution, review, verification).

say_en.text: Use claukit to plan a full-stack project.
say_en.note: Claude reads mission briefs and selects relevant skills.

say_en.text: Start claukit debugging workflow to fix this bug.
Review this code in claukit style.
